verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions any specific SDKs (JavaScript, iOS, Android, Python, Java, etc.) for sending events from web, mobile, or backend apps — it only discusses tracking methods generically (warehouse connectors, event ingestion server rewrite, export APIs) without documenting an SDK catalog. Missing for 10: explicit mention of official web SDK, mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), backend/server SDKs, and any platform coverage list.
